acceptanceCriteria: One test fails when the gitstatus constants, the conformance cases JSON and the MCPV0-028 list differ.
body: Decision 0383 review LOW. The closed reasonClass enum is written out in the gitstatus constants, class_test.go, the conformance test, the cases JSON and the spec/decision, and cmd/corvint-mcp/main.go:31 has its own unclassified literal. They match today, but no test ties them, so they can drift silently.
title: mcp: tie the reasonClass enum lists together with one cross-check test
